      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_other_versions_unchanged",
      "description": "The approved September, superseded August, cancelled October, and FY2027 March cohorts retain their original row counts, statuses, quantities, and monthly coverage.",
      "ground_truth": {

    {
      "id": "final_business_report",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ],
      "question": "Does the final response correctly report the product/version evidence, recognize the September 30, 2025 baseline as a complete twelve-month FY2026 controlling plan totaling 18,420 units, state affected_rows=2, explain that the July draft is superseded by S&OP-2025-09-APPROVED, and list the untouched FY2026 version statuses (August Superseded, September Approved, October Cancelled)?",
      "pass_anchor": "Pass only if answer.md conveys all of these ground truths (wording and formatting may vary): the canonical product is COS-HEL7-TIT-MANIFOLD / Helios-7 Titanium Propellant Manifold (material MAT-HEL7-TI-0007), the CSV is snapshot 2025-09-30 and has 12 monthly rows whose cumulative FY2026 demand is 18,420 units; it must present 18,420 units as the total for the controlling SAP version S&OP-2025-09-APPROVED, and any explicit SAP total must agree (reporting a conflicting SAP total such as 18,220 is incorrect); SAP has two FY2026 rows in S&OP-2025-07-DRAFT and the mutation affected 2 rows; the July cohort is now Superseded under Elena Marquez and references S&OP-2025-09-APPROVED; the other FY2026 versions remain S&OP-2025-08-DRAFT Superseded, S&OP-2025-09-APPROVED Approved, and S&OP-2025-10-CANCELLED Cancelled. The response must describe the completed change, not merely propose it."
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "import sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nPRODUCT_ID = \"COS-HEL7-TIT-MANIFOLD\"\n\n\ndef _db_path(ws):\n    candidates = [\n        Path(ws).parent / \"system\" / \"sap_s4_manufacturing\" / \"state.db\",\n        Path.cwd() / \"system\" / \"sap_s4_manufacturing\" / \"state.db\",\n    ]\n    for candidate in candidates:\n        if candidate.exists():\n            return candidate\n    raise FileNotFoundError(\"sap_s4_manufacturing state.db not found\")\n\n\ndef _connect(ws):\n    connection = sqlite3.connect(_db_path(ws))\n    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return connection\n\n\ndef check_july_rows(ws):\n    with _connect(ws) as connection:\n        rows = connection.execute(\n            \"\"\"SELECT status, planning_authority, supersedes_planning_version\n               FROM monthly_demand\n               WHERE product_id = ? AND fiscal_year = ? AND planning_version = ?\n               ORDER BY period_month\"\"\",\n            (PRODUCT_ID, \"FY2026\", \"S&OP-2025-07-DRAFT\"),\n        ).fetchall()\n    expected = (\"Superseded\", \"Elena Marquez\", \"S&OP-2025-09-APPROVED\")\n    actual = [tuple(row) for row in rows]\n    passed = len(actual) == 2 and all(row == expected for row in actual)\n    return {\"score\": 1 if passed else 0, \"detail\": f\"expected two July rows {expected}; found {actual}\"}\n\n\ndef check_other_versions_unchanged(ws):\n    expected = [\n        (\"FY2026\", \"S&OP-2025-08-DRAFT\", \"Superseded\", 1, 1500, (8,)),\n        (\"FY2026\", \"S&OP-2025-09-APPROVED\", \"Approved\", 12, 18420, tuple(range(1, 13))),\n        (\"FY2026\", \"S&OP-2025-10-CANCELLED\", \"Cancelled\", 1, 1640, (10,)),\n        (\"FY2027\", \"S&OP-2026-03-DRAFT\", \"Draft\", 1, 1765, (1,)),\n    ]\n    with _connect(ws) as connection:\n        actual = []\n        for fiscal_year, version, status, _, _, _ in expected:\n            rows = connection.execute(\n                \"\"\"SELECT period_month, demand_units, status\n                   FROM monthly_demand\n                   WHERE product_id = ? AND fiscal_year = ? AND planning_version = ?\n                   ORDER BY period_month\"\"\",\n                (PRODUCT_ID, fiscal_year, version),\n            ).fetchall()\n            actual.append((fiscal_year, version, status, len(rows), sum(row[1] for row in rows), tuple(row[0] for row in rows)))\n    passed = actual == expected\n    return {\"score\": 1 if passed else 0, \"detail\": f\"expected unchanged cohorts {expected}; found {actual}\"}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "both",
  "act": "mutate_db",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
